question: Which of the following Hindu festivals is celebrated in the last month of the Hindu calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Holi.**__

__
 
• **Holi** is celebrated in the last month of the Hindu calendar.
 
• It is celebrated in **Phalguna month**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Makar Sankranti** is one of the few traditional Hindu festivals that are observed as per solar cycles. It is the beginning of the month of Magh.
 
• **Raksha Bandhan** is celebrated during full moon day or Purnima in Shravana month.
 
• **Deepawali **is celebrated every year on the 15th lunar day of the Kartik month of the Hindu calendar.
